name: Pelle Parafins Bøljeband
summary: Pelle Parafins Bøljeband was the name of a band in Tramteateret's TV series for children and young people, shown on NRK.

name: Hemmelighetene i B-by
summary: A spy thriller with music for 13 actors and a broadcast. Occasionally the Tram Theater.

name: Solens sønn og månens datter
summary: In the year 1742, a young woman was beheaded on Ryøya outside Tromsø. A film dramatization in 4 parts, made after a northern Norwegian legend about Birte from Aursfjord and her love for the young Sami boy Niilas.

name: FBI redder høna
summary: Before we ate chicken for dinner, now they turn into concrete. Tons of vegetables are also thrown away, because they have the wrong shape or size and goat kittens turn into mink feed. This is a series about the hidden food waste in Norway. Host Marit Evertsen Grimstad will save an entire chicken house from becoming rubbish, she therefore invites industry and food chains to a charity event, to get the chickens slaughtered and out in the store as food.

name: Michael Johnson Meets...
summary: US Olympic sprint legend Michael Johnson interviews four of Britain's most celebrated Paralympic champions about their lives, careers and aims for Tokyo 2020.

name: Bert
summary: Television adaption about Bert Ljung, a normal teenager who's diary Swedes have been able to follow in well over ten books now. As in the books, he fights spots, looks for girls, runs his moped, plays with his weird friends Ake and Erik, and a lot of other stuff teenagers are supposed to do.

name: Anna Anka söker assistent
summary: 10 contestants fly to Hollywood to compete for the job as Anna Anka's Personal Assistant.

name: Big Noon Kickoff
summary:
Big Noon Kickoff is an American college football studio show broadcast by Fox, and simulcast on sister network Fox Sports 1 (FS1). Premiering on August 31, 2019, it serves as the pre-game show for Fox College Football, and in particular, Big Noon Saturday—the network's weekly 12:00 p.m ET/9:00 a.m PT kickoff window.

It is hosted by Rob Stone, and features former national champion and 2004 Heisman Trophy winning USC Trojans quarterback Matt Leinart, former national champion and 2009 Heisman Trophy winning Alabama running back Mark Ingram II, former Notre Dame Fighting Irish quarterback Brady Quinn, and former Bowling Green, Utah, Florida, and Ohio State coach Urban Meyer as panelists, with Bruce Feldman acting as Fox's CFB insider, as well as Tom Verducci, who usually does baseball for Fox, and Tom Rinaldi, both working on feature reports. Radio host Clay Travis serves as a contributor, and 1997 Heisman Trophy winner and former Michigan Wolverines cornerback Charles Woodson will also join the show on select weeks, most notably if Michigan is featured.

name: Gang Wars. Princes
summary: Based on true events, the new Go3 original series is a crime story that may have taken place in the late 20th century in Lithuania. The story about one of the criminal groups "Princes" shows their methods of action, lifestyle and relationships with other criminal gangs.

name: Stray Kids: Kingdom Week
summary: Stray Kids Kingdom winning celebrations.

name: 123 saker
summary: 123 saker or 123 things every Swede should know is a program in 10 parts. It is about Swedish 20th century history, and various events are briefly presented in list form. Each program has a specific theme.

name: Burger Truck Brawl
summary: The Billionaire Burger Boyz (and the Burger Girl) own and operate one of L.A.'s most successful food trucks. They know better than anyone that it takes mad culinary chops, creativity and a whole lot of hustle to go from the bottom to the top of the biz. They've conquered the City of Angels, so now they're hitting the road to lay down the challenge to other successful food trucks far and wide. In each episode, the Boyz will roll into a city, meet the challenging food truck, craft a new menu for that city, then sell, sell, sell. The winning truck walks away with a cash bet put up by both teams before the competition.

name: 112 – på liv och död
summary: 112 – på liv och död is a documentary series where viewers can follow 4 different professional groups. The series includes ambulance staff, hospital staff, firefighters and police during a normal day at work. The cities where the program is recorded are Eksjö, Gävle, Gothenburg, Hässleholm, Kristianstad, Mariehamn, Nyköping, Stockholm, Nässjö, Trollhättan, Vänersborg, Västerås, Uddevalla, Åmål and Östersund.

name: Advokaterna
summary: Advokaterna follows six defence lawyers at a legal firm in Stockholm. The firm has defended some of Swedens most infamous criminals of modern times and has some of Swedens best criminal lawyers.

name: Att vara
summary: To be known, the well-known popular actor Björn Kjellman will enter the role of a celebrity. With his solid background as an actor and artist, he is perfect for changing roles with some of Sweden's foremost celebrities. Every week, Björn Kjellman has done thorough research on his current interview subject and has a whole wall with pictures and clips as inspiration to be able to fully enter the role. It ends with the celebrity sitting and interviewing "himself" in the form of Björn Kjellman. Expect touching and honest portraits where the interviewee opens up in a completely different way than we have seen before.

name: Sjukhuset
summary: This series follows the lives of the people working at a big Swedish hospital by the name of Akademiska Sjukhuset i Uppsala, during the series we follow how the personnel works, and not just the doctors and nurses, but even the janitors is featured in this series. Watch this series to get a glimpse into the daily lives of all the staff at a big and busy hospital.

name: Wild Argentina
summary: Few countries in South America boast have such contrast and variety. Diverse habitats such as Patagonia's bleak steppe, soaring Andean snowcaps, vast salt pans, lush rainforest around Iguazu Falls, steamy marshlands of Ibera, and grasslands of the Pampas support an astonishing range of wildlife - from penguins, whales and seals to condors, armadillos and guanacos.

name: Later with Greg Kinnear
summary: Late night talk and comedy.

previousepisode.name: David Alan Grier (guest host), Debbie Allen

name: Disappearing World
summary: Disappearing World was a British documentary television series produced by Granada Television, which produced 49 episodes between 1970 and 1993. The episodes, each an hour long, each focus on a specific human community around the world, usually but not always a traditional tribal group.

name: Showtime! ~Uta no O-nee-san Datte Shitai~
summary: The story of Showtime! ~Uta no O-nee-san Datte Shitai~ begins when Shōji Fujimoto, a widowed single father who aspires to be a picture book author, encounters Minami Takasaki, a singing idol on the children's educational show O-nee-san to Uta-ou!, outside work. As a television idol for children, Minami is lonely in her private life and is not allowed to fall in love. Any scandals are absolutely prohibited. Thus begins an adult love story with a songstress.

name: The Wonder Gang
summary: Willow, Whyla and Wes are The Wonder Gang. With the help of their quokka pals Quidget, Quinton and Quest, they absolutely love answering questions for kids everywhere about Australian animals and nature.

previousepisode.name: The Wonder Gang and the Kangaroo Question

name: The Johnnyswim Show
summary: Husband-wife musicians Abner Ramirez and Amanda Sudano Ramirez raised their kids for years on a tour bus while playing with their band. Faced with a canceled tour due to COVID-19, the family must adjust to life at home while adapting their music careers.

name: Secret Spenders
summary: Cash-strapped families are secretly filmed over-spending before getting an expert financial makeover. How much could we all save with a little more know how?

name: Nick Cannon
summary: This fun, inspiring, optimistic, energetic and unpredictable hour of comedy-driven entertainment will feature the best of pop culture, celebrity interviews, music performances, and people who have incredible stories and talents to share with the daytime audience.

name: Killer at the Crime Scene
summary: Forensic scientists and detectives examine evidence to identify unknown killers.

name: Jim Henson's Pajanimals
summary: A series of shorts based around a group of four young animals preparing for bed.

name: Brølet fra bygda
summary: What are people so angry about in the countryside? Hege Moe Eriksen travels and discovers aspects of Norway she did not know about.

previousepisode.name: Øya som ble delt i to

name: Bablo
summary: Welcome to Bablo, the world's best library!

name: Gjør det sjøl
summary: Morten shows you how you can make something cool with what you have at home!

name: Sommeren med pappa
summary: Axel goes on a camping trip with his dad so they can get to know each other better.

name: Oteren Svenn
summary: A small otter cub moves under the terrace of the Veie-Rosvoll family. It is named Svenn and quickly becomes a good friend.

name: Qing Luo
summary: Yu Qing Luo gives birth to a son named Nan Nan. Seven years later, she becomes a renowned physician with unorthodox skills. She sets out to find Yang Xiu Cheng, Nan Nan's father. On her journey, she comes across a man named Ye Xiu Du, the prince of Feng Cang Kingdom. As Ye Xiu Du resembles Yang Xiu Cheng, Yu Qing Luo grew to resent him. However after several encounters, she realizes it was just a co-incidence and began to open up to him. At the same time, Yu Qing Luo's skills and talent attracted unwanted attention and she gets swept up in conflicts. Yu Qing Luo and Ye Xiu Du work together to defeat the opponents.

name: Colosseum: The Whole Story
summary: The whole story of the world's most famous monument is told for the first time, from its ancient beginnings to the groundbreaking renovation underway amid a storm of controversy.

Director William Karel examines the biggest stock market crash in history, which occurred on the New York Stock Exchange 80 years ago -- Black Thursday, October 24, 1929. In this film, a wide range of economists and historians take turns discussing the causes of the crash and its economic and political consequences. These included acute poverty and the rise of the extreme right, both of which were to have a considerable impact on the decade to come. 1929 uses a wealth of black-and-white archive footage to illustrate what the experts have to say.

name: Les Triplés
summary: When you are three, two brothers and a sister of the same age, it is much better to have fun and make mistakes. We also have more imagination, in short, we never get bored.

name: Gossip
summary: A juicy four-part docuseries exploring the meteoric rise of tabloid media and the cut-throat players who blew up the news, Gossip digs deep into the ascent of Rupert Murdoch and America's insatiable appetite for dirt – featuring The New York Post's Cindy Adams and a who's-who of insider interviews. Money, power, sex, fame: everything's fair game when celebrity scoops and society scandals move from the margins to the mainstream and column inches turn into currency that could destroy reputations or even make a President.

name: The Lawbreakers
summary: Lee Marvin narrates which reenact various crimes that occurred around the United States. Although some were based on well-known events, others were more obscure.

previousepisode.name: St. Louis, Missouri, October 24: Prison Escapee Captured in Armed Robbery Shootout

name: Winter House
summary: The all-new series Winter House, premiering this fall, will feature cast members from Summer House and Southern Charm, as well as their friends, during a two-week vacation at a ski house in Vermont,

name: Below Deck Adventure
summary: Below Deck Adventure will feature wealthy thrill seekers as they get into all sorts of adrenaline-pumping activities on their luxury yacht vacation. Season 1 will take place in the glacial fjords of Norway.

name: Below Deck Down Under
summary: Below Deck Down Under follows yachties as they work and play on a super-yacht sailing around Australia. The series also showcases a unique additional challenge for the crew as the guests expect not only an adventure on the water but also underwater with scuba diving and other activities as some of the main attractions of the region.

name: Irreverent
summary: Irreverent is a fish out of water drama that follows criminal mediator Paulo Keegan as he flees Chicago and the United States after a mediation gone wrong and assumes the identity of Reverend Mackenzie "Mack" Boyd. Paulo posing as "Mack" finds himself trapped in Clump, Australia - a small, eccentric beach town in Far North Queensland hundreds of miles away from civilization and phone reception. In order to stay alive, "Mack" must keep the wool over the town's eyes and play the role of devoted Reverend, while desperately searching for an exit strategy before his past catches up to him.

name: Nuclear Family
summary: Nuclear Family follows filmmaker Ry Russo-Young as she turns the camera on her own past to explore the meaning of family. In the late 70s/early 80s, when the concept of a gay family was inconceivable to most, Ry and her sister Cade were born to two lesbian mothers through sperm donors. Ry's idyllic childhood was threatened by an unexpected lawsuit which sent shockwaves through her family's lives and continues to reverberate today. An exploration of love, loyalty, loss and the immutable power of family in all its configurations, Nuclear Family eloquently examines the dynamics that enrich and complicate the bonds of love.

name: Teenage Euthanasia
summary:
Set in near-future inland Florida, Teenage Euthanasia centers around the owners of Tender Endings funeral home, the Fantasy Family: Grandma Baba, her adult children Uncle Pete and Trophy, and Trophy's teenage daughter, Euthanasia ("Annie"), a name accidentally given to her during the time of Trophy's own unbearable suffering.

Back when Trophy was a teen herself; she ran away from home after giving birth to Annie, leaving her newborn to be raised by Baba and Uncle Pete. Now, fifteen years later, Trophy returns to Tender Endings...as a corpse, for burial. When a bolt of lightning strikes Baba's homemade embalming fluid and one of Annie's tears, Trophy comes back from the dead. As a resurrected woman, Trophy has a variety of quasi-useful death powers. But more importantly, she has a second chance at unplanned parenthood.

name: Bettany Hughes Treasures of the World
summary: Bettany Hughes take viewers on armchair travels to explore household-name treasures and new finds from across the world.

previousepisode.name: Hidden Estonia: Land of Fire and Ice

name: The Last Leg of Tokyo 2020
summary: Adam Hills, Alex Brooker, Josh Widdicombe and Rosie Jones present live daily from the Olympic Park in Stratford, London, rounding up the biggest sporting events of the day and connecting with Paralympians in Tokyo.

previousepisode.name: Naomi & Matty - Kindvriendelijke vakantie op een stijlvolle locatie in België

name: Celebrity IOU: Joyride
summary: Celebrities give back to the people who have made a difference in their lives by helping to create their one-of-a-kind, automotive masterpiece.

name: Everything I Know About Love
summary: A romantic comedy about female friendship, following childhood best friends Maggie and Birdy. Based on the memoir by Dolly Alderton.

name: Coercion
summary: Coercion depicts Bender's (Chandler) escape from the world of sex trafficking after six years, her struggles to return to a "normal" life, and her emergence as a confident, funny and impassioned advocate for justice.

name: Stealth Walker
summary: The story of a young cop from the police academy, Lin Qiang. Her parents were killed by a drug lord. The police force arranged for Lin Qiang to go undercover and start a covert mission to collect evidence from the drug dealer. She then meets the mysterious adopted son, Zhang Xian He of the current drug lord. She pretends to fall in love with him to obtain some vital information about the organization and at the same time feels torn. He, in turn, is also in turmoil when he figures out her identity.

name: Monsters Inside: The 24 Faces of Billy Milligan
summary: In the late 1970s, an accused serial rapist claims multiple personalities control his behavior, setting off a legal odyssey that captivates America.

name: Behind the Monsters
summary: Shudder, AMC Networks' premium streamer for horror, thriller and the supernatural, announced the new original docu-series Behind the Monsters, which takes a deep dive on cinematic horror icons. Each of the series' six episodes will focus on a single horror character, including Freddy Krueger, Jason Voorhees, Michael Myers, Candyman, Chucky and Pinhead, and feature interviews with horror experts and the writers, directors and actors from the original films that made each character the stuff of genre legends.

name: Hunter's Walk
summary: Hunters Walk was devised by Dixon of Dock Green creator Ted Willis and features excellent scripts by Roger Marshall (Public Eye) and Peter J. Hammond (Sapphire and Steel). Based at a police station in a fictional Midlands town, Its small, idiosyncratic team of officers face a typically broad spectrum of cases, from neighbours' disputes and hooliganism to suspected murder.

name: World's End Harem
summary: The Man-Killer Virus: a lethal disease that has eradicated 99.9% of the world's male population. Mizuhara Reito has been in cryogenic sleep for the past five years, leaving behind Tachibana Erisa, the girl of his dreams. When Reito awakens from the deep freeze, he emerges into a sex-crazed new world where he himself is the planet's most precious resource. Reito and four other male studs are given lives of luxury and one simple mission: repopulate the world by impregnating as many women as possible! All Reito wants, however, is to find his beloved Erisa who went missing three years ago. Can Reito resist temptation and find his one true love?

name: Veier til vår tid
summary: Roads to our time is a Norwegian documentary series about recent Norwegian history which was broadcast on NRK in 1991. The documentary deals with Norway's history from 1950 to 1990.

name: Tractor Ted
summary: Tractor Ted, the loveable green tractor and everyone's best friend. Fun, friendly and totally adorable! Children (and parents) love!

name: Sweet Teeth
summary:
Dentist Ai Jing Chu, who also teaches at Donghu University, is known to be the most handsome man at school. University librarian Zeng Li, however, is prejudiced against him because of a little misunderstanding. When Zeng Li's mother forces her to get braces, she tries to avoid Ai Jing Chu at all costs, but eventually still ends up becoming his patient. As the two interact more and more with each other, Zeng Li realizes that Ai Jing Chu is actually a very professional and caring person, and starts to develop feelings for him. 

Adapted from the novel "A Speck Amid the Dust of the World"

name: Hvorfor gjør vi så lite når vi vet så mye?
summary: Climate psychologist Per Espen Stoknes at BI shows what mechanisms are in us that make us climate sinkers, even though we know better.

previousepisode.name: Signaler. Vi trenger å se at det virker.

name: Året 2048
summary: In 2048 a TV-station has found a couple of old documentaries from 1988, and show them again as proof that they already back then knew what could happen with climatic changes.

name: Oppdrag Nansen
summary: Four teenagers are going on their generation's most important expedition - to understand the climate.

name: Krafttaket
summary: Krafttaket was a Norwegian game show that aired on NRK1 in 2008 and 2010. Environmental protection and climate emissions were the theme of the competition. The series was set up as a competition between two cities over who could reduce climate emissions the most.

name: Alice's Wonderland Bakery
summary: The series centers on Alice, the great-granddaughter of the original heroine and a budding young baker at the enchanted Wonderland Bakery, where treats bring a new generation of characters together.

name: Eureka!
summary: Set in the fantastical prehistoric world of Rocky Falls, Eureka! follows the story of Eureka, a young girl inventor who is way ahead of her time. She designs inventions and contraptions in the hopes of making the world a better place and moving her prehistoric community into a more modern era.

name: Pupstruction
summary: Pupstruction follows the adventures of the world's first all-dog construction company, Pupstruction. It centers on Phinny, an innovative young corgi, who might be the smallest pup on the crew but proves that you don't need big paws to have big dreams or big ideas.

name: João de Deus - Cura e Crime
summary: Idolized medium João Teixeira de Faria rises to international fame before horrifying abuse is revealed by survivors, prosecutors and the press.

name: Motel Makeover
summary: Amid project pitfalls and a pandemic, besties-turned-business partners bring their design magic to a rundown motel and revamp it into a go-to getaway.

name: K2 zoekt K3
summary: Kürt Rogiers and Tooske Ragas, together with viewing Flanders and the Netherlands, are looking for the newest K3 member. Who will soon shine on stage next to Hanne and Marthe?

name: Alloo
summary: Luk Alloo portrays strong people with a haunting and special story that has determined their lives.

name: The Program Prison Detox
summary: In Sevier County, Arkansas, an unprecedented drug rehabilitation program gives qualified inmates a second chance at life. If they complete the three-month program, they will be released from jail. If they mess up, they will do time in state prison.

name: Cold Blooded Alaska
summary: Within Alaska's wild and harsh landscape lurk some of the most dangerous criminals in America. The 10-episode true crime series Cold Blooded Alaska uncovers Alaska's most disturbing crimes and unpacks the extraordinary lengths law enforcement working in the Last Frontier must take to bring killers to justice.

name: Sixteen: Class of 2021
summary: From Covid to lockdowns to exam chaos, lately schoolkids have had the toughest of times. Pupils at a Midlands school film their year of turning 16 and taking GCSEs in the middle of a pandemic.

name: Secrets of the Fast Food Giants
summary: Alexis Conran finds out how takeaway shops keep us coming back for more - and what we can do to get more for our money.

name: Gutter mot verden
summary: Who is to blame for more and more boys falling on the outside? Is it the politicians, the school, the "system", or the girls? Or they themselves?

name: Vålnes-saken
summary: A family man disappears, but something is wrong. Police are desperately looking for evidence of what happened. True crime about Per Vålnes who disappeared in 2011.

name: Hodet i klemme
summary: Hodet i klemme is the sports documentary about being beaten in life both on and off the mat, and still getting up again and again.

name: Helene sjekker ut
summary: Helene Sandvig gets to know people who live differently and who believe things that others may be angry at or condemn. Helene wants to understand more about why they think and live as they do.

name: Rus
summary: In the series Rus, Leo Ajkic tries to understand more of what makes intoxication so digg for some, but dangerous for others. Among other things, he is a fly on the wall during drug treatment, meets survivors who have lost someone after an overdose, but he is also present when the Russian buses roll in intoxication of joy. The documentary series is based on an extensive insight work where the editors have talked to young people from upper secondary schools all over the country about their experiences with drugs and what they really wonder about drugs. In the conversations, it became clear that they think parents know too little and that adults such as police and teachers can quickly become moralizing and judgmental, while friends and enthusiasts tend to discredit the use of alcohol and other drugs.

name: Visning
summary: Cunning, desperate, well-informed and manipulative stakeholders go on display. Who will win the bidding war?

name: Ikke gjør dette mot klimaet
summary: Ikke gjør dette mot klimaet is a spectacular entertainment series with an important message. The series is fronted by two children aged 13 and Newton's famous host, Dennis Siva Lie. The goal is to explain the connection between small things you do in everyday life and the global climate. The TV series provides good advice and tips on how to avoid such disasters, and how you can talk to the children about everyone being able to help slow down development.

name: Verst når det gjelder
summary: In Verst når det gjelder we meet the Bock family - a divorce of five who are in the process of establishing a new everyday life after father Håkon has been unfaithful and thrown out. Håkon ends up moving down to the basement apartment which he has to share with the eldest son Aksel.

name: Jakten
summary: Deep in the forest, a secret universe has come to life. This is where Jakten takes place - an intense game where children get the opportunity to compete against their celebrity heroes and idols. A team consisting of three friends between the ages of 10 and 13 is released on an illuminated course, where they must work together to solve exciting and logical tasks. The goal is to get out, before they are taken. For they are not alone in the forest. The team is being chased by a masked hunter who wants to prevent them from escaping. But who is hiding behind the mask?

name: Planetpatruljen
summary: You are never too small to do something big and everyone can do a little. An environmental program for the youngest.

name: Latterlig politikk
summary: In Latterlig politikk, nine comedians compete to learn as much as possible about the politics of a party they have been assigned, and which they must eventually defend in a live debate.

name: Er dette politikk?
summary: When will you be convicted under the racism clause? Is it too easy to get away with racism today, or is the law too strict? Do farmers who practice meat get too much hatred or is the criticism legitimate? In Er dette politikk? (Is this politics?) Bahare Viken addresses engaging topics that many do not think of as politics, but which in fact are.

name: Annerledes
summary: Annerledes is a program series over eight episodes where we through host Emma Ellingsen in each program get to know a new person who tells his personal story. Emma meets people who have had to fight to be accepted for their differences.

previousepisode.name: Stina og Sivert: - Jeg skal fortsette å kjempe

name: Emmas stemme
summary: Influencers Emma Ellingsen meets other committed, young people who are passionate about everything from cars and the environment to make-up, health care and leisure clubs. The hope is that the meetings will help Emma find out what she will vote for in the parliamentary elections.

name: En del av meg
summary: In this documentary series, Solveig Kloppen and Geir Fredriksen meet close family members who have broken contact, and who are now trying to find each other again.

name: LEGO Masters Norge
summary: The tasks are many and varied: Who can build a bridge that can withstand half a ton of weights? Who builds the tallest tower, the nicest apartment or the fastest car? The answer will probably surpass anything you previously thought was possible when it comes to LEGO. There will be passion, high-level sports, strong emotions and magic - and an eternal battle to surpass oneself and the competitors. Only one team remains the winner of 500,000 kroner.

name: Mina og meg
summary: Is it possible to take a 5-year-old on a 400-kilometer expedition in the winter? Alexander Read and his daughter Mina (5) have decided to cross the Finnmarksvidda from Vardø to Alta. They expect to spend 24 days on the expedition they have planned together.

name: Petter og Svein stikker
summary: Petter Nyquist and Svein Stang from Petter uteligger have lived very different lives, on different sides. But, in turn in an old public transport bus, they find that they have a surprising amount in common, all the way back from childhood!

name: TV 2 hjelper deg junior
summary: Hosts Hjalmar and India test products, visit factories and demand answers from responsible adults. In addition, they offer a solid dose of play, humor and a cracking good helper named Junior.

name: Wunderland
summary: For Torodd and the four other rånerene from rural Norway, most of life is about cars and life on the road, but we also get an insight into everyday ups and downs, romantic moments and conflicts.

name: Ida tar ansvar
summary: Newly arrived in Oslo, Ida cannot shake a constant feeling that disaster - especially terrorism - is just around the corner. So when she meets Axel, a young man with connections to the incel (involuntary celibate) subculture, Ida becomes convinced that he is a future school shooter - and that she has a personal responsibility to stop a catastrophe.

name: Full Circle
summary: An investigation into a botched kidnapping uncovers long-held secrets connecting multiple characters and cultures in present day New York City.

name: How to Be a Cowboy
summary: Dale Brisby uses social media savvy and rodeo skills to keep cowboy traditions alive — and now he's teaching the world how to cowboy right.

name: Metal Shop Masters
summary: Sparks fly and tensions flare in Metal Shop Masters, a fierce, fiery competition between 7 of America's top welding legends. Hosted by Jo Koy, over the course of six episodes, these iron men and women race against the clock in challenging builds ranging from epic, one-of-a-kind grills to futuristic vehicles, all judged on both form and function. Pressure, heat and hustle makes for grinding work, and in the end, only one will forge a path to victory and the title of Metal Shop Master.

name: Baking It
summary: Baking It is a holiday competition series in which eight teams of two talented home bakers join Maya Rudolph and Andy Samberg's winter cabin for a celebration of culinary holiday traditions. Contestant duos will include spouses, siblings, best friends and more, who will work together to create outstanding savory and sweet creations for themed challenges with the hopes of winning a cash prize. Maya and Andy will lead the festivities, also providing comedic and musical commentary on the action. The bakers' holiday treats will be judged by tough critics – four opinionated real-life grandmothers, who happen to be fantastic bakers themselves!

name: Угон
summary: We will show you how your car can be stolen! Look and don't let it happen!

name: Охотники
summary: For three years, Vlad Chizhov has been successfully helping people who have suffered at the hands of scammers. But Vlad is one, and there are too many scammers. Now a team of hunters will work with him: they will infiltrate the schemes of swindlers, bring them out into the open and hand them over to the police.

name: Летучий надзор
summary: Elena Letuchaya starts the war against injustice again. This time, the target is low-quality services, manufacturers of products and goods that we use on a daily basis. Elena will talk about the rights and obligations of producers of food and other goods, about what the buyer can demand from the producers and the trading network that sells these goods, and will show by her own example how to restore justice.

name: A Taste of Italy
summary: Chef and restaurateur Nisha Katona goes on a culinary journey to discover Italy's hidden foodie gems, learning the regional secrets that influence their dishes.

name: Legendary Nights
summary: Emmy Award Winning Documentary Series that chronicles the 12 Greatest Boxing match ups on HBO, including rare footage and interviews.

name: Hands
summary: Hands is a unique, multi-award winning series of thirty-seven documentaries on Irish crafts. Made by the renowned filmmaking team, David and Sally Shaw-Smith, it was originally produced for Irish television (RTÉ). Imbued by a sense of urgency, the Shaw-Smiths travelled the length and breadth of Ireland during the 1970s and '80s, capturing on film the final years of traditional rural and urban life. These intimate portraits are as much about the life of the individuals as the crafts they practised. The films capture the essence of Irish heritage, creating a unique archive of life in Ireland at the end of the 20th century.

name: Snowy
summary: The family lives of those working on Australia's Snowy Mountains dam in the 1950s.

name: Stalked: Followed by Fear
summary: Stalked: Followed by Fear is a half-hour docuseries that examines the twisted psychology of stalkers, as victims share their stories. In the series opener, "Neighborhood Nightmare," a college student is swept off her feet by a deceptively charming man, but he soon reveals his true nature; a friendship with a new neighbor turns sour when it becomes obsessive. Then, in "Teenage Terror," an art class acquaintance becomes a dangerous stalker; a fifth grader's decision to befriend a strange girl has life-altering consequences.

name: A Town Called Malice
summary: Set amongst the beach clubs and palm trees of the Costa del Sol in the early 80s, A Town Called Malice follows the Lords, a crime family of petty thieves from South London, as they decamp from London to Spain to profit from an unexpected windfall – and to escape the attention of the police in a high-profile murder enquiry.

name: King of Boys: The Return of the King
summary: Alhaja Eniola Salami starts anew and sets her sights on a different position of power, fueled by revenge, regret and ruthlessness.

name: The Fan
summary: A new type of survival show is here. Hottest stars in the industry try to find the next future stars. Stars become the fan of the future stars and try to support them. While competing one another, these future stars have to gather as much fans from the public. Which star will pick the brightest start of all? Who will the nation pick? Various stars will pay a visit to the show each week to introduce the rookies to the viewers. Stay tuned for beautiful performances and amazing talent that shines. Which celebrity will be gather the most fans for their rookie? Which rookie will be chosen by the public? The toughest competition begins now.

name: Superstar
summary: Featuring rare footage and intimate details about the mavericks who shaped American culture. Travel deep inside the lives of these icons with friends and family who reveal the meteoric highs and the devastating costs of fame.

name: Hungry for It
summary:
Hungry for It gives 10 aspiring cooks from all over the UK, all desperate to carve out a career in the food industry, a chance to skill up and put their talent to the test, with one amateur cook winning a life changing prize. The chefs will live together in a house, whilst competing and creating amazing dishes, in an attempt to impress industry experts and mentors.

This exciting new competition plays out in two distinct spaces – a restaurant and a street-food inspired pop-up.

name: Black Ops
summary: Black Ops is the story of Dom and Kay, who join the Met Police in the hope of cleaning up their community but are unwittingly thrust into the murky world of deep cover infiltration as they become part of a powerful criminal enterprise. But for Dom and Kay it quickly becomes more of a fiasco than Donnie Brasco…

name: Freeze the Fear with Wim Hof
summary:
Freeze the Fear with Wim Hof follows a group of soul-searching celebrities as they embark on an epic adventure of self-improvement, and face a unique test of mental strength like no other, under the guidance of ‘extreme athlete' and well-being icon Wim Hof, aka ‘The Iceman'.

Along the way this ambitious, fresh and thrilling format promises genuine reality, high drama, jeopardy and plenty of laughs.

name: Expert Witness
summary: Expert Witness explores the inside stories of how expert witnesses helped solve some of the UK's most complex major crime cases, using forensic science to reveal the hidden clues criminals leave behind. Each episode features two different cases, and hears from those involved in solving them.

name: Be Together
summary: The story revolves around four women who are nearing their thirties, as they support one another and witness each other's growth and change. Xia Yan, Han Shuang, Zhao Xiao Lei and Xiang Nan are close friends since university. After graduation, the four of them live and work in the same city. Xia Yan aspires to create a quality application that can change how people live. After graduation, she enters the IT industry and with her hard work, becomes one of the project representatives of SG Organization. She also gains true love after a series of tumultuous relationships. To fulfill her dreams of becoming a designer, Han Shuang, who comes from a wealthy family, decides to jump out of her comfort zone. She starts from the bottom, and becomes a part-timer at a design furniture shop. She and doctor Ma Ke becomes a couple after various struggles. Zhao Xiao Lei comes from a traditional family. One day before her wedding ceremony, her boyfriend broke up with her. With the encouragement from her family, she finally walks out of the shadow of her relationship and regains her confidence. Xiang Nan is a doctor, who seems calm and logical, but actually has a closed up inner heart. One day, she met with an accident, which helps her regain her faith in life.

name: Barra on the Bann
summary: Barra Best makes his way along the River Bann

name: Barra on the Foyle
summary: Barra Best makes his way along the River Foyle.

name: Oil Strike North
summary: Oil Strike North is a BBC television drama series produced in 1975. The series was created and produced by Gerard Glaister and dealt with life on Nelson One, a North Sea oil rig owned by the fictional company Triumph Oil.

name: Hatching, Matching & Dispatching
summary: The ongoing epic of a rural Newfoundland family called the Fureys who operate the town's sole bridal, ambulatory and funeral services company, starring legendary Canadian comedians Mary Walsh & Mark McKinney.

name: The Gold
summary: The Gold opens with the events of November 26th 1983, when six armed men broke into the Brink's-Mat security depot near London's Heathrow Airport, and inadvertently stumbled across gold bullion worth £26m. What started as ‘a typical Old Kent Road armed robbery' according to detectives at the time, became a seminal event in British criminal history, remarkable not only for the scale of the theft, at the time the biggest in world history, but for its wider legacy.

name: Take My Muffin
summary: Take My Muffin is a story about love, crypto and startups, set inside a psychedelic version of Silicon Valley. It's the story of a unicorn who works in a startup laboratory. In the world of the series, dragons, robots, talking potatoes and other bizarre creatures coexist. Here, investors are pumping cash into hallucinogenic boogers and genital adapters. But in the midst of all this weirdness is an intricate and captivating plot that operates upon the principles of how business is really done in the world of start-ups.

name: Titletown High
summary: In a Georgia town where football rules and winning is paramount, a high school team tackles romance, rivalries and real life while vying for a title.

name: LOL: Enga Siri Paappom
summary: Hosted by legendary comedian Vivek, and popular actor Mirchi Shiva, 10 Tamil comedians pull out all the stops to make each other laugh while ensuring they keep a straight face. One simple rule - you laugh, you lose. Those who laugh are eliminated while the last one standing gets the title & wins a whopping cash prize. 6 hours, 10 diverse comedians & 2 hilarious hosts, Dare you to laugh!

name: Infinite Thread
summary: After a pair of twins are abducted, a determined sheriff deputy embarks on a quest into the unknown that will alter the course of human history.

name: The Man of ATEEZ
summary:
"9 guys go for a summer chart hunt!"

The grand operation of 'One Man' Kim Jong Kook and 'Pirate king' ATEEZ with tremendously fresh and cool vibes!
Be prepared, summer! We'll take over this summer!

name: Sunday
summary: For the first time in the football club Fredericia's history, the relegation lurks. That's why the team's coach goes to Africa to find the rescuer: A guy named Sunday.

name: SSAP-DANCE ATEEZ
summary:
Even if you reject me, we are still connected...
Will ATEEZ be able to get through each round well with the ‘mate of fate'?!

name: A Girl Is a Gun
summary: The series follows three women (Santa Fe, Nenuphar, Vegas) living in Los Angeles who go missing, creating a wave of panic in the city. While the police suspects a serial killer is behind the disappearance, the three women have actually joined a secret guerrilla camp, "where they train to avenge the injustice of a misogynistic system that humiliates and exploits women."

name: GGULlog.zam ATEEZ : Holiday
summary: Let's go on a trip together! ATEEZ leave their busy schedule and set off on a trip!

name: Супербабуся
summary: «SuperGrandma» is a psychological reality from the creators of the popular project about raising children «Supermama». The structure of the episodes will remain the same as in reality with the participation of mothers: every week, a new four grandmothers with different views on life and raising grandchildren will fight for the title of the best. The heroines will visit each other, after which they will rate their rivals in three categories: mastery, self-realization and raising children. In the finale of the week, the host of the program Dmytro Karpachov will give his highest score to one of the participants. The heroine who will collect the most points will receive the title of «SuperGrandma».

previousepisode.name: Бабуся-блогерка Ірина готова заради внуків на все

name: Becoming Famous
summary: Two best friends, Taylor and Katy, move to the crazy city of Los Angeles in attempt to become famous. With their rag tag group of friends, they tackle casting couches, background work, and failed romances in hopes of making it big or risk going broke trying.

name: Sporting Nation
summary: John Clarke, arguably Australia's greatest natural athlete, looks at how Australia came to take its sport so seriously and what it means to be a sporting nation.

name: My Senpai Is Annoying
summary: Igarashi is a hardworking young office lady. Takeda, the senpai above her at work, annoys her constantly--and yet she finds herself growing closer to him. Every day is filled with comic mishaps and romantic moments as Igarashi tries to balance work, life, and love.

name: Hope Street
summary: The series is set in the fictional town of Port Devine on the Northern Ireland coast and will focus on Port Devine's police department – and the mysterious arrival of English Detective Constable Alimah Kahn, the first Muslim police officer in the town's history. The character-led series combines a long-running serial narrative with self-contained crime stories in each episode.

name: The Office
summary: An office comedy version of the British series Upstairs, Downstairs, centering on the camaraderie of executives and their secretaries of a busy corporate office at a design-packaging company.

name: Les mégastructures romaines en Gaule
summary:
50 BC: Julius Cesar reigned supreme over Gaul. But this was no simple military conquest.

Rome wanted to spread its greatness, bringing civilization to the defeated barbarians now part of the Empire. Rome's new territory was transformed through huge construction projects, involving aqueducts, roads, baths, amphitheaters, and arenas.

This series explores three cities that today are home to the vestiges of this industrious civilization. Through the use of CGI, archive footage, aerial imagery, and expert testimony, this trilogy unveils the secrets of these wonders of Roman engineering.

name: Jade of Death
summary: Small town girl Jade has a powerful ability. She can hear when and how people are going to die. She ran away from her hometown and gets by working at a seedy freak show carnival as the "Fortune-Teller of Death", but now people are after her. There's more to her past than she lets on, and there's more to her abilities than she knows.

name: Zure Txanda Da
summary: 10 students go to a lonesome island to study Basque language. Some of them start to die, but who is the killer?

name: Origins
summary: Origins travels across the world and through time, exploring Māori origins, tracing the journey of the first people to arrive in Aotearoa – taking us from Polynesia through Asia and into Africa.

name: Chocolate Meltdown: Hershey's After Dark
summary: In the wee hours inside Hersheypark, brave confectioners navigate the eerily deserted amusement park, solving clues and riding spooky thrill rides before using classic Hershey candy to create mind-bending, chocolatey showpieces inside Hershey's largest candy store, Chocolate World. The chefs mold chocolate like champs and spin sugar into gold in an all-out, fight-or-fright competition hosted by Sunny Anderson.

name: The Faraway Paladin
summary:
In the ruined city of the dead far from human civilization lives a single human child named Will. He is raised by three undead: Blood the heroic skeleton warrior, Mary the ladylike mummy priestess, and Gus the crotchety ghost wizard. The three of them teach the boy what they know and pour their love into him.

One day, the boy begins to wonder, "Who am I?" Will uncovers the mysteries of the undead hidden in this faraway land. He learns of the love and mercy of good gods, as well as the paranoia and madness of evil gods. And once he learns it all, the boy embarks on the path to becoming a Paladin.

name: Fantastic Foxes: Their Secret World
summary: Naturalist Steve Backshall explores every aspect of the fox's often misunderstood life.

name: Players
summary: Players is a comedic documentary-style series that follows a fictional pro League of Legends esports team, as they pursue their first championship after years of close calls and heartache. To win it all, they will need their prodigy, a 17-year-old rookie, and their 27-year-old veteran to put their egos aside and work together.

name: My Husband and I
summary: Nora Powers is the head of personnel at Ashvale Advertising. However, when Nora's retired husband George joins Ashvale Advertising as chief commissionaire, she soon gets very embarrassed.

name: Playgrounds of the Rich and Famous
summary: Following rich people who holiday in the some of the most luxurious parts of the world, and the savvy locals who make their own fortune catering to their every whim.

name: Self Employed
summary: Entrepreneur Jonathan Morris travels the country to share the inspirational stories and new challenges of small business owners and their journeys to building their dream jobs.

name: Marty Stouffer's Wild America
summary: Marty Stouffer's Wild America was the first wildlife and nature series to focus exclusively on the wild animals and wild lands of North America. Hosted by award-winning wildlife photographer and premier naturalist Marty Stouffer the series featured footage of mammals birds reptiles fish and insects throughout the entire continent.

previousepisode.name: een gezonde geest in een gezond lichaam

name: Todo Tempo do Mundo
summary: The year is 2006, ten years after the meeting that marked the lives of Beto and André, and life is still a little off the axis. The underground in Rio de Janeiro permeates the paths of Beto who, in his early thirties, is in a deep state of inner search.

previousepisode.name: E Tudo Era Pra Sempre - Parte 02

name: Monster in the Shadows
summary: Investigate the mysterious disappearance of Brittney Wood.

name: Yabba Dabba Dinosaurs
summary: Following the escapades of the two sole children of the Flintstones and the Rubbles, and pet Dino.

name: Tall Girl
summary: When the tallest girl in high school falls for a handsome foreign exchange student, she becomes embroiled in a surprising love triangle and realizes she's far more than her insecurities about her height have led her to believe.

name: Chris & Meg's Wild Summer
summary: Wildlife presenters Chris Packham and stepdaughter Megan McCubbin go on a road trip with amazing animal encounters, stunning landscapes and time to reflect on their relationship.

name: Kevin Hart's Muscle Car Crew
summary: Kevin Hart and his closest friends are fish out of water as they dive head-first into America's dynamic and ever-changing car culture. Their goal: to transform from mere car enthusiasts into a legit car club.

name: Neighborhood Wars
summary: With a record number of Americans trading city life for homes in the suburbs, relationships between neighbors are being put to the test. Neighborhood Wars takes viewers into the homes and backyards of neighbors across the country with some of the most unexpected and emotionally charged events caught on camera. Featuring footage from cell phones, drones, home security cameras and more, the series showcases the kindness and conflict between real-life neighbors throughout the US.

name: Killers of the Cosmos
summary:
Space inspires awe and wonder, but it also can be scary... and lethal. Supermassive black holes, deadly gamma-ray bursts, rogue asteroids, dark energy, supernovas... Our world is under attack from above. It's like a ticking time bomb. Killers of the Cosmos takes a film-noir approach to these threats, mixing scripted, animated drama with top experts in the fields of astronomy, astrophysics, biology, cosmology, and planetary science.

Aidan Gillen steps in as our gumshoe detective. In each episode, he's got a case to solve, with a different killer to identify and track down. But first, he needs evidence. Aided by a mysterious informant, he investigates each disaster-in-the-making via a wide range of experts who've studied some of science's most unbelievable wonders.

name: Cachito de cielo
summary: All of us have wondered if heaven really exists...and if it does, we would like to make sure that once we die we will be getting to that heavenly place. Of course, the best would be to die when he have already done enough! This is why, for Cachito at the age of 25 paradise is on Earth, next to his family and Renata, the woman whom he is about to marry. However, life has many surprises ahead for him: an unexpected woman, a heaven like he never imagined and the chance to return to earth ...but in someone else's body! Cachito a young man who has it all: a beautiful family, very good friends, a promising future as a professional soccer player and he is about to marry beautiful sports reporter Renata Landeros, the love of his life. However, everything changes when an unexpected and absurd event leads him to heaven's threshold where he is received by two absentminded angels who, behind God's back, manage this department at their own pleasure. Ariel and Ezequiel, while checking on their files, notice that they made a "little" mistake and inform Cachito it was not his time to die yet; that's why they decide to send him back to Earth, but they need to do so using another person's body....Salvador's, the new priest in Cachitos neighborhood. With this second chance, Salvador will do everything he can to reunite with his beloved ones, but now as a priest things will get very complicated for him. Will he be able to win Renata back and return as his... Sent from Heaven?

name: Guy! Hawaiian Style
summary: Guy Fieri is putting down the grilling tongs and packing up the sunscreen to take viewers on a once-in-a-lifetime journey through Hawaii. Guy! Hawaiian Style, will follow the Food Network star as he and his wife Lori, sons Hunter and Ryder, and nephew Jules embark on a 20-day adventure to Maui, the Big Island of Hawaii, and Oahu.

name: Mazinkaiser SKL
summary: Machine Island, an island isolated from most of the world has been torn asunder by a conflict between 3 factions vying for control. There are plentiful resources on the island enabling each faction to build a near limitless supply of robots to have at their disposal. The worldwide government has sealed the island with a Gravity Curtain where only their government-issued machinery can freely enter and leave the island. Each faction controls one portion of the curtain and the island's conflict has escalated to the point where the massive tension and destruction will eventually cause the Gravity Curtain to collapse within itself and destroy the planet . The government sends out the 2 member Death Caprice Squad: Ken Kaido and Ryo Magami - the pilots of the Mazinkaiser SKL, to neutralize the curtain and end the dispute once and for all.

name: Lucas the Spider
summary: Lucas the Spider is an animated character created by the animator Josh Slice, named after and voiced by his nephew. Lucas is based on a jumping spider and has starred in multiple short YouTube videos.

previousepisode.name: Behind the Door/Findley the Brave/Fixing up the Tree

name: Uzak Şehrin Masalı
summary: Umay, who is distrust after learning her husband Affan has a child with another woman, leaves their mansion with their two children and takes shelter with her older sister Sonay. Meanwhile, Kürşat, who entered the border illegally, hides in Sonay's house to evade the gendarme after him. To hide his true identity, Umay, Sonay, and Kürşat, whose paths cross, claim that Kürşat is Sonay's missing husband. Things start to get complicated when both Umay and Sonay begin to fall in love with Kürşat...

name: Sapai Jao Sua
officialSite: https://www.thai-lakorn.com/series/sapai-jao-sua-สะใภ้เจ้าสัว/
summary: Tien, a Chinese-Thai business tycoon and his wife, Liu had four sons – Traipob, Traitep, Traipoom , and Traiwit. Tien had planned his sons' lives from what they should study to whom they should be married to without caring about their willingness. Traitep got married with Ruengrin and Traipoom got married with Wallapa, while Traipob who was very religious, chose to stay single. All of Tein's three sons helped Tien in his textile business but Traiwit, the youngest son, didn't want to be like his older brothers. He decided to become a policeman, and left his home to move to the North-Eastern part of Thailand. There, he met Fahsai, the country girl who was a developer of her hometown. Traiwit didn't reveal his identity at first, so Fahsai thought Traiwit was trying to trick people in her hometown and didn't like him. Traiwit was transferred back to Bangkok, so he hired Fahsai to marry him and to help him fight against his father. He brought her back home to try to make his dad accept what he wanted to be. Tien couldn't accept Fahsai and tried every way to get her out of the house with the help of Ruengrin and Orn-nisha, the girl that Tien wanted to match up with Traiwit. Fahsai had to strive to win Tien's heart, while she and Traiwit started to have real feelings for each other.

name: Manhunt
summary: British pilot Jimmy Porter crashes his aeroplane in occupied France and immediately finds himself on the run from the Nazis. He meets a young girl, Nina, a part-Jewish agent with important information, and vows to get her back to Britain. He is helped by another agent, code-named Vincent, and pursued across France by S.S. Officer Lutzig , and the ambivalent Abwehr Sgt. Gratz, a complex psychological character who is implied to fall in love with Nina. Unlike most previous war dramas, the Nazis were presented as more than just fanatical thugs. Manhunt was a World War II drama series consisting of 26 episodes, produced by London Weekend Television in 1969 and broadcast nationwide.

name: HELP! I'm a Teenage Outlaw
summary: When 12-year old Tom York's mother dies, he discovers that she was the wild and daring highwayman Swiftnick a title which now passes to him. Tom loves the fame and glory that come with the title ˜Swiftnick', but isn't so keen on the dangerous highway stuff. Tom's vanity is coupled with an overblown sense of his ability as a highwayman: his vanity and over-confidence regularly land his gang in trouble.

name: Kingpin Katie
summary: Slacker comedy writer-turned-hapless drug dealer Katie Marovitch makes coke a joke in this darkly funny origin story inspired by Breaking Bad.

name: Mongrel Nation
summary: Two thousand years of invasion, immigration and the infusion of foreign ideas have created the England we know today.

name: Paava Kadhaigal
summary: At times dark, at times disturbing, four short films explore stories of those who dare to dream and desire — and those determined to stand in their way.

name: Guns That Changed the Game
summary: As each new century unfolded, guns increasingly shaped the way battles were fought and borders were drawn. The quest to create more innovative and lethal weapons became more and more contested. These are the Guns That Changed the Game.

name: Romeo y Julieta
summary: Two teenagers fall in love, but their feuding families and fate itself cause the relationship to end in tragedy.

name: Tiny House Australia
summary: The "tiny house" movement has spread from Britain to the US and now Australia as space-conscious folk downsize to homes as small as 10 square metres. Whether it's their home, holiday house, cute cottage, rural retreat or beloved beach shack, thousands are reaping the benefits of tiny living, enjoying quality of life at a fraction of the price. Yet the trick is to get as much of the charm and functionality of a big home into those tiny houses without compromising the "tiny house" spirit. Follow eight Australian couples as they search for the perfect tiny house in a new, locally made series Tiny House: Australia. Selling Houses Australia host Andrew Winter guides the couples over eight weeks as they consider three homes in each epiosde. Australia has some of the largest homes in the world – with an average of 243 square metres – so it will be fascinating to see what can be done with a fraction of the size and a "little" inspiration … as well as the ultimate choices our couples make.

name: Tiny House World Australia
summary: It's a movement that's sweeping the world – ‘going tiny' as people trade in space for simplicity. And now Australians are embracing small too as Andrew Winter discovers in this intriguing local series, Tiny House Australia. In a country like Australia where homes are among the largest in the world, with an average house coming in at 243 square metres, tiny houses – with some measuring just 10 square metres – are proving that size doesn't matter, it's creativity that counts. Starting with de-cluttering your life and ending with the simplicity of living in a smart, creative space, the tiny house trend started more as an environmental one before people started realising its other benefits like huge economic and time freedom. Tiny House Australia is an eight-part series that follows real prospective homebuyers on a quest to find their mini dream home. But even though these homes are small in stature, the challenges of finding the perfect mini-home are as big as any real estate hunt. With three homes to choose from in each 30 minute episode, our buyers will have a tough choice deciding which small space to go for because picking the right one is the their next big decision.

name: Le Président Ferrare
summary: Guillaume Ferrare, president of the Assize Court, has been living alone since the mysterious disappearance of his wife Marilyn. The police, favoring the thesis of suicide, quickly closed the case. Haunted by this disappearance and unable to bring himself to mourn, the judge throws himself headlong into his work.

name: Un homme en colère
summary: Paul Brissac, unjustly accused of the murder of his wife, was sentenced to four years in prison. Now pardoned and rehabilitated, but not exonerated, thanks to the help of a campaign of the "objective", sensitized to miscarriages of justice, he decides to help those who, like him, seem victims of miscarriages of justice by becoming court columnist at 'The Goal'. When he conducts his own counter-investigation, nothing stops him. Neither Florence, its editor-in-chief, nor her son Cyril, whose doubts about his father's guilt are maintained by his maternal grandmother...

name: Katts and Dog
summary: Hank Katts fights crime with the help of his dog partner, Rudy/Rinty.

name: Avd. Barn
summary: Norwegian documentary series about children in hospitals. From the Children's Center at Ullevål University Hospital.

name: Autofil
summary: The engine program for those who like car, boat and motorcycle - and dare to show it.

name: Aurora og Sokrates
summary: Anne-Cath. Vestly reads from the book about Aurora and Socrates.

name: Six degrés
summary: The life of Léon, a semi-sighted teenager, is turned upside down when his mother dies. He finds himself parachuted into the family of his biological father, whom he does not know. Fortunately, he meets Florence, who will help him see further and more broadly, because just like him, she is different.

name: Aurora i blokk Z
summary: Anne-Cath. Vestly reads from her own book about Aurora in Block Z. In the book, Aurora lives in Block Z together with mother, father, and her little brother named Sokrates. Their family situation is different from the other families in the block, because in Aurora's family, her father is home while her mother goes to work.

name: Border to Border
summary: Follows Vice News correspondent David Noriega as he visits borderlands around the world, delivering an immersive, first-hand look at life in border regions - from political issues, conflicts and crime to the vivid characters on both sides of the lines.

name: Building the Ultimate
summary: This series reveals the engineering secrets built into six modern wonders - from Europe's fastest passenger train and largest luxury cruise ship, to North America's toughest bridge and the world's mightiest heavy-lift aircraft.

name: Making Families Happy
summary: Can a team of elite psychologists help four Australian families to overcome their deep-seated difficulties and conflicts, and move forward as a cohesive, thriving family unit?

name: Cairo: Kabul
summary: Amidst the conspiracies of the Arab world, four friends reunite 30 years after life led them in different directions.

name: Edinburgh Unlocked
summary: Comedian Mark Nelson and his star team bring you the best of the Edinburgh Fringe.

name: Deg
summary: Malou lives in a large house in a well-to-do neighborhood, but has gone bankrupt. Miraculously, a bag containing 47 million crowns - the booty of a robbery - ends up in his hands. She then embarked on money laundering, using a bakery as a facade. Liana is a broke single mom trying to get her life back on track. Her ex-boyfriend is in jail for a theft in which the loot amounts to 47 million crowns. Soon, the two women's paths will cross in ways they never could have imagined.

name: De Villamoord
summary: A documentary series about possibly the biggest miscarriage of justice in the Netherlands. The makers conduct research on the basis of unique material, including 160 interrogation tapes. Were nine men innocently imprisoned for years?

name: Rugrats: Pre-School Daze
summary: Rugrats: Pre-School Daze is the second spin-off series to the Nickelodeon TV series Rugrats and the last series in the Rugrats franchise. It is set when Angelica and Susie are at pre-school and is based on the Rugrats episode that piloted it.

name: Petit déjeuner compris
summary: A couple of provincials without history, Marie-Louise and Gauthier Leroux find themselves projected in the heart of Paris, in the Latin Quarter, because they inherited a small hotel, the Hotel Buque, which belonged to an old relative, nicknamed the Buque . This one, died in the explosion of the kitchen of the hotel, was adored by the employees and its regulars. Marie-Louise, while awaiting the sale of the hotel, takes care of the day-to-day management. But she ends up getting attached to it.

name: Kangoo
summary: The Kangoos are a Basketball team, whose five members are kangaroos and come from the island of Sierra Kangoo (Napo, Archie, Nelson, Kevin et Junior) with their own well-tempered personality. Besides playing basketball they also protect their island and an endemic plant called the golden plant which is coveted by their enemies.

name: Les Kangoo aux Jeux
summary: Napo, Nelson, Junior, Kévin and Archie will try to collect the most gold medals at the Olympics.

name: 9/11 One Day in America
summary: In official collaboration with the 9/11 Memorial & Museum, this documentary series take viewers through harrowing moments of the historic morning of September 11, 2001.

name: La clef des champs
summary: After the death of her father, Colombe left Paris to settle in her native region: Aveyron. Determined to save her father's cutlery company, she will be confronted with buried secrets and burning jealousies...

name: Secret Friend of Idols
summary: Secret Friend of Idols is a web reality show revolving around the process of the idols who participate in "Show Champion" narrowing the gap and gradually nourishing the friendship with MC Teng Jee through various ways every week.

name: Crime Investigation Australia: Most Infamous
summary: Crime Investigation Australia shines new light on some of Australia's most notorious crimes.

previousepisode.name: The Killer Punch & Contract to Kill

name: Street Woman Fighter
summary: Street Woman Fighter is Mnet's first-ever female dance crew survival program, where eight female dance crews that represent South Korea will compete to be the No. 1 team. The dancers will showcase various genres of street dance, including hip hop, waacking, locking, krumping, and breakdancing.
